name: Tawnos's Tinkering — the rider's "it" is an artifact, creature or land you control
notes: Found by the audit (2026-11-17). "Put two +1/+1 counters on target artifact, creature, or land you control. Untap that permanent. If it isn't a creature, it becomes a 0/0 creature in addition to its other types." The rider's antecedent (_branchAntecedent) stopped at the first comma of the list and read "target artifact", so the picker listed only artifacts. Now it lists every artifact, creature and land you control, and a land picked becomes a creature (the counters are put on by hand, as with every spell).
